predictions.quote: This going to be a pill format. Yeah, that's ours. That's coming next year.
predictions.prediction: Eli Lilly will launch its oral GLP-1 pill format next year (2026).

predictions.quote: We've told the street expect singledigit deflation in this category over time. 5% a year it goes down uh or more.
predictions.prediction: GLP-1 drug prices will decline by roughly 5% or more per year going forward, as guided to investors.

predictions.quote: Everything we make goes to zero because of the patent system. So in 2030 something Mjaro will go to zero.
predictions.prediction: Sometime in the 2030s, Eli Lilly's Mounjaro will lose patent protection and its revenue will decline to zero as generic/biosimilar competition enters.

predictions.quote: We're currently constructing six plants. We're going to announce four more in the next 6 months.
predictions.prediction: Within the next 6 months (from September 2025), Eli Lilly will announce four additional US manufacturing plants, on top of the six already under construction.

predictions.quote: Our competitor Nova is going to read out a study in a few months on dementia risk. It probably won't be positive. That's my guess. But it will probably be in the right direction.
predictions.prediction: Within a few months (from September 2025), Novo Nordisk will release results from a dementia-risk study of its GLP-1 drug; the results will likely trend in a positive direction but probably will not reach statistical significance.

predictions.quote: So we are now right now starting studies in bipolar disorder and major depressive disorder along with these addictive hedonic pathways... so we'll get that drug in three or four years if it works.
predictions.prediction: If current trials succeed, Eli Lilly will bring a new GLP-1-based drug targeting bipolar disorder and major depressive disorder to market within three to four years (by roughly 2028-2029).
